facts.business: Kajaria Ceramics Limited manufactures and sells ceramic and vitrified tiles in India.
facts.related_party_note: The Company has provided loans and guarantees to Subsidiaries/Joint Ventures/Others during the year. Aggregate amount provided/granted during the year: Subsidiaries - Guarantees ₹20.00 crores, Loans ₹133.87 crores; Joint Ventures - Guarantees ₹42.18 crores; Others - Loans ₹8.60 crores. Balance outstanding as at balance sheet date: Subsidiaries - Guarantees ₹20.00 crores, Loans ₹260.76 crores; Joint Ventures - Guarantees ₹130.31 crores; Others - Loans ₹9.18 crores.
